text: Hardened pipeline tests and type checks: ArtifactKind now compares by label plus runtime type name, ArtifactTable.contains is kind-aware, graph dependency validation reports kind mismatches, and new tests cover same-label different-type rejection, builder immutability after failures, string output validation, and local/bounded/unbounded runner parity across inputs.
